title: End-to-end artifact intake: provenance-aware conversion, deterministic smoke, and policy-based pinning
creator: Nina Zhang
description: Implement a unified artifact intake pipeline for community/open-source LLM weights that preserves provenance metadata, performs deterministic binary conversions, runs a lightweight deterministic smoke suite, and outputs policy-driven pin recommendations for serving. The goal is a single, auditable path from inbound weights to a signed, versioned model artifact and a published performance profile that can be safely promoted to staging. This ticket covers orchestration, conversion container spec, provenance metadata schema, smoke test harness, and the initial pin-recommendation policy rules.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline ingests a model bundle with source metadata (origin URL, commit hash, license) and records provenance in the artifact manifest
Conversion containers produce bit-for-bit deterministic runtime artifacts given the same input bundle and conversion config
Deterministic smoke suite runs on the produced artifact and reports a standardized pass/fail + summary metrics (latency median P50, max mem, sample outputs for QA)
Pin-recommendation service emits a suggested pin (model id + variant + quant/ops profile) with rationale and compatibility tags
End-to-end run produces a signed artifact and publishes a performance profile JSON to the profile registry endpoint
All produced artifacts and logs are stored with retention and ACLs consistent with Private deployment constraints (no plaintext credentials in logs)
updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff meeting with PM, Design, and Runtime SRE. Agreed scope to prioritize deterministic conversion and deterministic smoke before expanding to advanced profiling.

2026-02-18: Prototype conversion container defined (dockerfile + hermetic build); initial conversion for a 7B hf checkpoint completed. Observed non-determinism in weight serialization across converter runs.

2026-02-22: Root cause for nondeterminism traced to unordered parameter iteration in legacy conversion script. Patch submitted to canonical converter (PR #312) to enforce deterministic ordering and stable RNG seeds.

2026-02-28: Deterministic smoke harness v0 added (10 short prompts, token-count & embedding sanity checks). Smoke failures flagged for a community GPT-style 3B model due to tokenizer mismatch; created follow-up ENG-112234.
2026-03-02: Security review triage: KMS integration required for artifact signing in Private; design doc created (Confluence). Marked security_review_required=true.

2026-03-04: Pin-recommendation policy draft reviewed by Runtime and Product. Policy uses sequence-length weighted latency + degradation tolerance thresholds to pick a default quant/profile. Feedback: add explicit rollback tags and compatibility matrix entries.

2026-03-05: Integration tests wired into CI with a single sample run against the staging runtime. End-to-end smoke passed for two internal test artifacts. Next: broaden test corpus and run perf collect.
Pending: add telemetry hooks for conversion failure reasons and contributor-visible error messages for community weight owners.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Community weights with nonstandard tokenizers or missing license metadata will fail pipeline and block onboarding. Mitigation: fail-fast with clear contributor-facing error messages and automated suggested fixes (tokenizer mapping, license detection heuristics). High-risk models will be quarantined and require manual review by Onboarding SME. Use canary stage to limit customer impact until pin is validated.
notes_for_reviewers: Focus review on deterministic guarantees (container reproducibility), provenance schema completeness (must record origin + signing + conversion config), and the pinning policy tradeoffs. Product asked for a conservative default pin that favors latency stability over absolute throughput; discuss if threshold tuning is needed.
